## Current behavior `ngc` places files in the wrong directory (`outDir` from `tsconfig.json` plus the name of the directory where I run `ngc` from (`.tmp` in my case). So all compiled files are placed in `dist/.tmp`. Running the same command with the same files and tsconfig using angular 4.4.5 works as expected - all files are placed in `dist` Reproduction - https://github.com/IlyaSurmay/ngc-reproduction ## Expected behavior `ngc` places compiled files in `outDir`. ## Environment 

Angular version: 5.0.0-rc.2

 
For Tooling issues:
- Node version: 8.2.1
- Platform:  Linux

body: Looks like if the `outDir` contains 2 path segments, e.g. `dist/common`, then this problem occurs (doesn't matter how many `..` before them).

issue.body:
### Steps to reproduce
* Clone https://github.com/jelbourn/metadata-out-repro
* `npm i`
* `./node_modules/.bin/ngc -p ./src/cdk/tsconfig.json`

### Expected behavior
Metadata is output to `dist/packages/cdk`

### Actual behavior
Metadata is output to `dist/packages/cdk/cdk`


The reproduction captures an issue affecting Angular Material when using Angular 5.
cc @tbosch @chuckjaz, originally reported by @crisbeto and @DevVersion
